newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh taka ends firmer in dull market.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh taka ends firmer in dull market.

text.p: The Bangladesh taka closed slightly firmer at 43.7470/7490 to the dollar in interbank trading against the previous at 43.7490/7498, dealers said on Saturday.
The taka lost its early gain after opening at 43.7350/7450 as some banks sought dollar for import payments.

The interbank call money rates closed higher at 7.75 percent to 9.5 percent against the previous 6.5 to 7.0 percent. There was shortfall in liquidity due to payment of treasury bills worth 50 million taka by the commercial banks, the dealers said.
